info.title: Ashicore Agent Production Planning API
info.description: Read-only production-planning context for external AI assistants. The ERP remains authoritative for planning calculations; this API returns the current board state and planning facts for reasoning.

get.description: Returns a compact Markdown production-planning brief by default. Use format=json only for debugging or full-context clients. Read-only: does not create manufacturing orders, purchase orders, allocations, or inventory events.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response format. Defaults to markdown, which is the recommended compact format for ChatGPT and Claude.

parameters.name: includePlanningFacts
parameters.description: JSON-only. When false, omits large planning fact arrays. Ignored for markdown, which is always compact.

parameters.name: includeLots
parameters.description: JSON-only. When false, returns inventory items without lot detail. Ignored for markdown, which is always compact.

200.description: Current production-planning context. Markdown is the default compact agent brief; JSON is available with format=json.

schema.description: Compact production-planning brief with counts, allocate-now queue, make/buy recommendations, setup reviews, blockers, and read-only rules.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, or expired agent API token.

403.description: The token does not have production-planning read scope.

agentBearerAuth.description: Use an Ashicore agent API token generated from the ERP. In ChatGPT Actions, configure authentication as API Key or Bearer token so requests send Authorization: Bearer <token>.

inputHash.description: Stable hash for the planning inputs. Future write workflows should compare against this before acting.

items.description: Inventory context. availableQty is current usable on-hand after reservations; projectedQty is planning-derived future net quantity. Inventory-lot allocations and manufacturing-output allocations are split into separate fields.

decisionSupport.description: Agent-facing decision indexes: a sorted decision queue, allocation needs, and make/buy/review recommendations without price data or draft action payloads.

planning.description: ERP planning snapshot, including horizon, assumptions, rows, facts, recommendations, blockers, paths, warnings, and inputHash. Agent output omits cost fields, draft action payloads, and per-parent recipe ratios.
